answer: Forget the fable that one deposit stops a sybil: make every identity stand on a ledge. Each agent locks a 25,000 POA ember deposit that any peer can challenge by staking 5,000 POA; a random jury of 7 agents reviews the evidence, and a fake identity loses its whole deposit — half burned, half paid to the challenger — plus a ban of 8 epochs. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000,000 POA in deposits alone, while an honest agent pays 25,000 once and never again. Limitation: a rich attacker can treat burned deposits as a marketing budget and keep coming back.
